issue.title: test_agent_header_panel.py facade imports test_hint_document_forces_expansion, deleted by c6b802a647 (ImportError breaks contract collection)
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel.py` is a re-export facade over the split
`test_agent_header_panel_basic` / `_preview` / `_scroll` modules. Commit c6b802a647
(feat(agents): keep sticky header collapsed in hint mode, plan
202609/sticky_header_hints_respect_collapse.md, agent 0uh) deleted
`test_hint_document_forces_expansion` from `test_agent_header_panel_basic.py` and added
`test_hint_mode_keeps_collapsed_header_unchanged` and
`test_hint_mode_numbers_expanded_header_first`, but left the facade importing and
`__all__`-listing the deleted name.

Impact: importing the facade raises ImportError at collection, so every pytest run that
collects it errors. `pytest -m contract --collect-only` exits 2, which makes
`tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection` fail
and `just refresh-contract-manifest` unusable on master.

Fix (root cause known): update the facade's import list and `__all__` to the current
basic-module names, dropping `test_hint_document_forces_expansion` and adding the two
`test_hint_mode_*` tests. (`test_hint_expanded_header_claims_scroll` still exists in the scroll module.)

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic ImportError at module import (cannot import name 'test_hint_document_forces_expansion' from tests.ace.tui.widgets.test_agent_header_panel_basic); reproduces on every collection of a clean tree at 69c4057735 and origin/master 9f989395b5.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing sase-1cj.12: the contract-manifest check cannot run on master because this facade fails to import, and nothing tracks it yet.

evidence.note: Reproduced at master 788a9311f8 while landing epic sase-1d7: pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel.py -> 1 error during collection (ImportError: test_hint_document_forces_expansion). Also proposed as follow-up by phases sase-1d7.12 (note 1 item 4) and sase-1d7.13 (note 2); not caused by sase-1d7.

Proposed by sase-1dm.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1: 'TUI header panel ImportError for test_hint_document_forces_expansion'); independently reproduced by the sase-1dm land agent on master be6daf95d1: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel.py' errors at collection with ImportError: cannot import name 'test_hint_document_forces_expansion' from test_agent_header_panel_basic. Still breaks every just check test lane that collects the facade.

Independent reproduction on HEAD 8fdead6466 (2026-10-01): pytest -m contract --collect-only -q exits 2 with ImportError collecting tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel.py (cannot import test_hint_document_forces_expansion from test_agent_header_panel_basic), which makes tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection raise RuntimeError. Unrelated to the g-prefix split: no g_prefix reference in either test module.

Still reproduces on clean master 0abe894140 (sase-1dq land verification; proposed by sase-1dq.3--1 and sase-1dq.8--1): tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel.py collection ImportError, and tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection fails with 'pytest -m contract --collect-only failed (exit 2)'.
